name: bikes
description: Bicycles and electric bikes, and their parts.

ships.description: True when the seller ships the item. False or absent: handed over in person.

howDealsGo: In person, the buyer looks it over, pays and releases in one tap. Shipped, the buyer pays into escrow first and releases when it arrives as described; the seller records the delivery in their folder, and a timer to the seller, set past the expected arrival, pays if the buyer goes quiet. Before paying, check the frame number is not reported stolen.
